title: Fixed Deposit (FD): Invest Smartly & Safely — How does compounding work in Fixed Deposits? (ICICI Bank)
body:
How does compounding work in Fixed Deposits?:
- In a cumulative Fixed Deposit, interest is compounded annually. This means interest is calculated at the end of every year on the principal plus accumulated interest. The compounded interest is added back to the principal and the next year’s interest is calculated on this higher amount. Over longer tenures, compounding has a significant positive impact on your maturity amount. ICICI Bank's FD Calculator uses yearly compounding to show you the estimated maturity value.
What if I prematurely withdraw my FD?:
- If you close your Fixed Deposit before the chosen maturity date, ICICI Bank may apply a premature withdrawal penalty. The interest paid on the withdrawn amount may be lower than the contracted rate. The exact penalty depends on the tenure completed and the type of FD.
- Note that Tax Saver Fixed Deposits cannot be closed before 5 full financial years.

How to avoid the premature FD closure penalty?:
- To avoid a premature FD closure penalty, consider booking multiple smaller FDs instead of a single large deposit (a practice called FD laddering). This way, you can close only the FD you need funds from and leave the rest intact, avoiding unnecessary penalties.
- Alternatively, you may opt for an Overdraft Against FD offered by ICICI Bank, which allows you to borrow against your FD without breaking it, helping you meet short-term liquidity needs.
How to close a premature FD online?:
- To close an FD before maturity through ICICI Bank Net Banking:
- Move to to 'Deposits' > 'Fixed Deposit'
- Select the FD you wish to close and follow the steps for premature closure
- To close an FD prematurely through ICICI Bank's iMobile app:
- Choose the relevant FD and follow the prompts to close it
- Note that a premature withdrawal penalty may apply and certain FD types, such as Tax Saver FDs, are not eligible for premature closure before 5 full financial years.

title: Fixed Deposit (FD): Invest Smartly & Safely — How can I close my FD account? (ICICI Bank)
body:
How can I close my FD account?:
- You can close your ICICI Bank Fixed Deposit account at maturity or before maturity (premature closure) through the following channels:
- Through ICICI Bank Net Banking: Log in > Deposits > Fixed Deposit > Select FD > Choose closure option.
- Through ICICI Bank's iMobile app: Log in > Accounts & FD/RD > Deposits > Select FD > Follow the closure steps.
- You may also visit your nearest ICICI Bank branch for assistance.
- Note that Tax Saver FDs have a mandatory lock-in of 5 full financial years and cannot be closed before completion of this period.
Is TDS applicable on Senior Citizen FD?:
- Yes. TDS is applicable on Fixed Deposit interest earned by senior citizens. However, the TDS threshold for senior citizens is higher, TDS is deducted only when the aggregate FD interest exceeds ₹1,00,000 in a financial year (compared to ₹50,000 for general customers).

title: National Pension System (NPS) — Tax benefits under NPS (ICICI Bank)
body:

- The NPS tax benefit makes it an attractive choice for both salaried and self-employed individuals who wish to grow their retirement savings. Here’s how -

- NPS enables you to access a tax withdrawal of up to 60% of your retirement funds and enjoy savings benefits while offering flexible contribution options suitable for both employees and self employed individuals alike. title: RERA Account — Exemptions from RERA account (ICICI Bank)
body:
Exemptions from RERA account:
- Projects being developed on less than 500 square metres of land
- Number of units not exceeding 8 units in all phases
- Promoter has obtained the completion certificate before the commencement of this Act
- Redevelopment projects where no new allotments are to be done
- Renovation and repairs – without involving selling and marketing of apartments, plots or buildings
- As per the RERA guideline, 70% of the amount that is periodically realised for the real estate project from the allottees, will be deposited in a separate account that will be kept with us specifically to cover the cost of land and the cost of construction.
- The promoter can withdraw the amount from the separate account, to cover the cost of the project, in proportion to the percentage of completion of the project.
- The amount from the separate account can be withdrawn by the promoter after it is certified by an engineer, architect and a chartered accountant in practice that the withdrawal is in proportion to the percentage of completion of the project.
- The Authority, upon the revocation of the registration, will direct the Bank holding the Bank Account created for the project, to freeze the account and thereafter take further actions, including consequent de-freezing of the said account towards facilitating the remaining development work in accordance with the provisions of the Act.

- Buyers are assured that 70% of their payments are used towards the project completion by mandating the opening of a RERA Current Account. This will not only secure the investments of the buyers but also protect them from any default committed by the developer and project delays.
Can I open a RERA account with ICICI Bank to provide the account number to RERA for the issuance of the RERA registratio:
- Yes, you can open a RERA Current Account with ICICI Bank to provide the Account number to RERA. Once the account is opened, we will provide an account number basis the total freeze in the account. On submission of the RERA Registration Certificate issued by RERA to the Bank, the freeze will be removed and the account will be operational.

title: Health Insurance — What is Elevate policy? (ICICI Bank)
body:
What is Elevate policy?:
- Elevate policy by ICICI Lombard is a comprehensive health insurance policy that covers hospitalization, OPD visits, diagnostic tests, wellness programs and more. It is designed to offer all-round protection for individuals and families.
Is full body check-up covered by the Elevate plan?:
- Yes. Full body check-ups are available under the annual health check-up benefit. This is an add-on cover and can be availed by paying an additional premium.
Is OPD covered in the Elevate plan?:
- Yes, OPD expenses are covered only if the BeFit benefit has been purchased.
Which hospital room category can I choose under the Elevate plan?:
- Most Elevate plans offer coverage for private single AC rooms. Room eligibility depends on the variant chosen and ensures comfort during hospitalization.
What is the eligible age range for purchasing Elevate policy?:
- The minimum age limit for taking this policy is 18 years and there is no maximum age limit. Dependent children can be covered from 91 days and 30 years, financially dependent on the insured and does not have their independent sources of income

title: Health Insurance — Can I avail family floater or individual health policy in Elevate health insurance? (ICICI Bank)
body:
Can I avail family floater or individual health policy in Elevate health insurance?:
- Yes, Elevate offers both individual and family floater options. A family floater covers multiple family members under a single sum insured.
Are major corporate hospitals included in the network?:
- Yes, Elevate has a wide network of hospitals that includes leading corporate, private and multispecialty hospitals across India for cashless treatment.
Does the Elevate policy cover overseas treatment for illnesses?:
- No, Elevate covers medical expenses only within India. Overseas treatments are not included in this policy.
Is maternity coverage included under Elevate health insurance?:
- Yes, selected Elevate plans offer maternity coverage after a specific waiting period . It includes delivery costs and newborn baby treatment expenses.
How can I transfer my existing insurance to Elevate Health Insurance policy?:
- You can port your current health insurance policy to Elevate by applying at least 45 days before renewal.

title: Health Insurance — What is the difference between basic, essential and recommended plans? (ICICI Bank)
body:
What is the difference between basic, essential and recommended plans?:
- These plan types vary in benefits and coverage. Basic offers core coverage, Essential adds extra features and recommended provides the most extensive protection with higher limits and additional wellness benefits.
What is the maximum premium amount eligible for tax benefits?:
- Premiums paid for Elevate Health Insurance are eligible for tax deductions under Section 80D of the Income Tax Act—up to ₹25,000 for individuals and ₹50,000 for senior citizens.
Will my premium remain the same upon policy renewal?:
- Premiums may be revised based on your age, claims history, or product updates. However, all changes are shared transparently at the time of renewal.
How can I file a claim for post-hospitalization expenses?:
- You can file a claim by submitting bills, prescriptions and reports incurred during the 60-day post-discharge period. These are reimbursed as per policy terms.
What should I do in case of an emergency hospitalization?:
- In an emergency, visit the nearest hospital and inform the insurer or TPA within 24 hours of admission. You can avail cashless treatment if the hospital is in-network.

title: Health Insurance — What should I do if my claim is denied? (ICICI Bank)

Can I add my spouse to my existing individual health insurance policy?:
- Yes, your spouse can be added either at the time of renewal or during the policy term (subject to conditions). A revised premium will apply.
What is the tenure of Elevate policy?:
- The policy is available for 1, 2, 3,4 and 5 years. Longer tenures often come with premium discounts and uninterrupted coverage.
What happens if I don’t renew my policy on time?:
- If the policy is not renewed within the 30-day grace period, coverage will lapse and you may lose accumulated benefits like waiting period waivers and continuity.

Why is Life Insurance important?:
- Life insurance ensures your family’s financial stability when you are no longer around to provide for them. It helps cover living expenses, clear outstanding loans and secure your children’s education or your spouse’s future.

- Tax benefits: Premiums paid and payouts received are eligible for tax benefits under Sections 80C and 10(10D) of the Income Tax Act.*

title: Mutual Fund investments in India for NRIs through ICICI Bank — Eligibility Criteria for NRIs to Invest in Mutual Funds in India (ICICI Bank)
body:
Eligibility Criteria for NRIs to Invest in Mutual Funds in India:
- Residency Status: NRIs must be classified as non-residents under FEMA guidelines.
- Bank Account Requirement: Investments must be made through an NRE (Non-Resident External) or NRO (Non-Resident Ordinary) account. Use the NRE account for repatriable foreign income; use the NRO account for income from India.
- Source of Funds: The investment must be made through an NRE or NRO account through legitimate banking channels.
- Permitted Mutual Fund Houses: Most Indian Mutual Fund Houses (AMCs) accept NRI investments, but some may restrict investments from the USA and Canada due to FATCA compliance. Check that the AMC or platform accepts investors from your country of residence.
- Process Checklist: Check if any one-time registration is required at the Bank/platform level and follow the required process.
- KYC and FATCA Compliance: NRIs must complete Know Your Customer (KYC) requirements for Mutual Fund and Foreign Account Tax Compliance Act (FATCA) requirements.
